name: dashboard-icons
description: Find dashboard icons and retrieve their CDN URLs, SVG markup, variants, and license information.

interface.longDescription: Find icons for services, applications, and self-hosted dashboards. Match several service names, search the catalog, browse icons and categories, and retrieve CDN URLs, available variants, SVG markup, and license information. The public connection provides six read-only tools and requires no account. It cannot submit icons, manage accounts, or change the catalog.
defaultPrompt: Find icons for Plex, Nextcloud, and Home Assistant for my dashboard.
Show me the available icon variants and license for Grafana.
Find the SVG markup for the Docker icon.

publication.release_notes: Initial public icon connection with six account-free, read-only tools: match_icons, search_icons, get_icon, get_icon_svg, browse_icons, and list_categories.
